Resolution 709 (1991) of 12 September 1991

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of the Republic of Estonia for admission to the United Nations, 209

Recommends to the General Assembly that the Republic of Estonia be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

Adopted without a vote at the 3007th meeting
